name: PCSX-Redux [anylinux]
description:
PCSX-Redux is a modern, modular PlayStation 1 (PS1/PSX) emulator tailored for developers, reverse engineers, and retro gaming enthusiasts. Rewritten from the ground up, it combines high emulation accuracy with a professional debugging suite.

Features:
- Highly accurate MIPS R3000A CPU, GTE, and SPU hardware emulation
- Advanced debugging tools including disassembly views, memory inspectors, and breakpoint editors
- Modern OpenGL and Vulkan rendering backends with internal resolution upscaling
- Support for homebrew software development, GDB remote debugging, and custom scripting
- Gamepad controller support with remappable analog and digital layouts

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
